author: mapeadora
attribution: Photo: mapeadora, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Panoramax. Source: https://panoramax.openstreetmap.fr/#focus=pic&pic=225e88f9-049a-4687-a632-5d35acb16275. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. crop 70,0,3590,1844 of the 4096x1844 HD picture.
notes: Shopping centre facade, Bogotá, with motion blur and a tree trunk in front. 'Centro Comercial' is in raised serif letters over the arch; the name logo on both sides of it uses decorative ligatures and oversized initials (big C and R, small-cap remainder, 'DE' and 'CANDELARIA' with joined letters), transcribed here as plain capitals. The small address plate over the gate (apparently 'CLL 12 6-45') is too blurred to transcribe. The 'Imple Joyeros' sign at right is a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
